# Chapter 10 · Large-Sample Theory for Least Squares {.unnumbered}
*Consistency · Asymptotic Normality · Sandwich Variance · Wald Inference*

least squares의 consistency·asymptotic linear representation·asymptotic normality를 전개하고 sandwich variance, HC covariance, delta method, Wald inference와 robust inference의 범위를 정리한다.
